# KafkaUnderReplicatedPartitions

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-broker](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-broker/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** Broker <kafka_broker> leads under-replicated partitions

Followers of partitions led by broker <kafka_broker> (cluster <kafka_cluster>) are not in sync for a sustained period. Redundancy is reduced; check the follower brokers' disk, network and GC.

## Impact

Redundancy is reduced: one more failure can make partitions unavailable (or under min ISR).

## Diagnosis

1. The alerting broker is the LEADER; the slow follower is another broker. Kafka · Broker Deep Dive → Replica fetcher max lag shows which follower falls behind.
2. Look for a broker restart (uptime on Kafka · JVM), a running reassignment (reassignment bytes) or a saturated disk/network.

## Mitigation

- After a restart the broker catches up by itself — watch the lag go down.
- Persistent: give the slow broker more resources, throttle reassignments, check `num.replica.fetchers`.

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_replicamanager_underreplicatedpartitions) > 0
```
